When I interviewed for Facebook, I had a SQL interview.
When I interviewed for Amazon, I had a SQL interview.
When I interviewed for Google, I had a SQL interview.
When I interviewed for Spotify, I had a SQL interview.
When I interviewed for Airbnb, I had a SQL interview.

I have interviewed for Data jobs at 20+ companies.

95% of them involved one (or multiple!) SQL interviews

SQL is the most important skill in the Data industry.

I 𝘰𝘯𝘭𝘺 landed Data Analyst and Data Scientist offers because I had 𝘮𝘢𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘥 SQL.

———

This is why I built a SQL interview prep platform!

Interview Master was built based on my experience interviewing at 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘨𝘦𝘵𝘵𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘰𝘧𝘧𝘦𝘳𝘴 𝘧𝘳𝘰𝘮: Google, Meta, Amazon, Airbnb, Spotify etc.

On InterviewMaster, you'll find
↳ 200+ SQL questions from real companies & products
↳ Real-time & customized feedback on your queries
↳ AI coach to unblock you & help you learn faster

The best part? You can use Interview Master for FREE.

🐣 Beginner questions: https://lnkd.in/gR5JpR9e
🐓 Intermediate questions: https://lnkd.in/gXmAwh2S

———

PS: If you’re excited about this, I would appreciate if you hit the “repost” button. This way others in your network can see this too. ❤️

ai_analysis.summary: This is a self-reported account and promotional post about SQL interview preparation. The author says that 95% of their interviews at more than 20 companies included SQL and attributes their Data Analyst and Data Scientist offers to mastering SQL. The post advertises Interview Master, which provides 200+ company- and product-based SQL questions, customized query feedback, an AI coach, and free access. It does not provide SQL concepts, syntax, techniques, or worked examples.
